verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an official hosted MCP server that works with any MCP client. Through it, an agent can investigate destination delivery errors and monitor pipelines in natural language. Separately, the documented APIs let you programmatically manage connections and transformations. However, no evidence shows an agent creating sources and destinations, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit documented create-source/create-destination endpoints or MCP tools, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server

citations.quote: Explore the RudderStack APIs to programmatically manage your RudderStack connections, transformations and other RudderStack features.
Debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, review audit logs — all through natural language.
Investigate destination delivery errors and get root cause analysis
For Claude Code, run claude mcp add --transport http rudderstack https://mcp.rudderstack.com/mcp.
RudderStack MCP works with any MCP-compatible client like Claude, Codex, Cursor, Visual Studio Code (GitHub Copilot), etc.
